## Problem
Gerrit change 2788 patchset 2 hit a CI-only failure in tests/scripts/test_feature_branch_inventory.py::test_rebased_content_equivalent_branch_reports_merged on ubuntu-latest py3.13. The same rebased tree passed local full `make verify`, including that test, and adjacent Gerrit runs on the same current main completed ubuntu py3.13 successfully.

## Evidence
- CI run 34147719861, job 101823598582: assertion saw no inventory rows in result.stdout (`[]`) instead of the three fake feature branches.
- Targeted local reproduction in /Users/joeoakhart/dw1-3f5a passed.
- Full local verify after rebasing onto origin/main passed.
- RCA found ambient `BASH_ENV` inheritance could make `bash infra/gerrit/feature-branch-inventory.sh` return success before the script or fake git/curl shims ran, producing empty stdout and no diagnostics.
- Gerrit change 2800 added a deterministic hostile-`BASH_ENV` reproduction, sanitizes `BASH_ENV`/`ENV` from the test subprocess env, and improves assertion diagnostics.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] The feature-branch inventory regression test has deterministic diagnostics for empty stdout, including stderr/exit code.
- [x] The root cause of the CI-only empty output is identified and fixed or the test is made reliably isolated from CI environment state.
- [x] Targeted test and the normal verify gate pass.

## Testing
- `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest tests/scripts/test_feature_branch_inventory.py::test_rebased_content_equivalent_branch_reports_merged -q` passed.
- `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest tests/scripts/test_feature_branch_inventory.py::test_rebased_content_equivalent_branch_reports_merged -q -n 4 --dist worksteal --basetemp=/Users/joeoakhart/.copilot/session-state/d4d8a7bd-065c-430f-a674-aa966d8e5f8e/files/kinglet-basetemp` passed.
- `env -u GIT_CONFIG_COUNT -u GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0 -u GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0 -u GIT_CONFIG_KEY_1 -u GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_1 -u GIT_CONFIG_KEY_2 -u GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_2 PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest tests/interfaces/test_rebar_repo_isolation.py -q` passed.
- `env -u GIT_CONFIG_COUNT -u GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0 -u GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0 -u GIT_CONFIG_KEY_1 -u GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_1 -u GIT_CONFIG_KEY_2 -u GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_2 PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make verify` passed: 19997 passed, 80 skipped.
- Gerrit change 2800 received LLM-Review+1 and Verified+1; submitted and mirrored to origin/main at `d1bde07fbd5b`.

## File impact
- tests/scripts/test_feature_branch_inventory.py
- infra/gerrit/feature-branch-inventory.sh
